differences.a_observable: The camera is positioned at a low oblique angle relative to the grid plane, creating a dynamic perspective.
differences.b_observable: The camera angle is much steeper, closer to a top-down orthogonal view, reducing the perspective depth.
differences.fix: Match the camera's pitch and yaw angles to the reference video to capture the same oblique perspective.

differences.a_observable: The shadows cast by the cards are soft and highly diffused, blending smoothly into the background tiles.
differences.b_observable: The shadows are sharp-edged and dark, indicating a hard, direct light source.
differences.fix: Increase the light source size or shadow softness (radius) to achieve a more diffused shadow look.

differences.a_observable: The background tiles have a warm, creamy off-white color cast.
differences.b_observable: The background tiles are a neutral, cool white/light grey.
differences.fix: Adjust the white balance or color grading to introduce a warm, cream-colored tint to the white materials.

differences.a_observable: The yellow card has a subtle glossy reflection that catches the light as the camera moves.
differences.b_observable: The yellow card has a flat, matte finish with no visible specular reflections.
differences.fix: Increase the specular intensity or reduce the roughness of the yellow card material to match the glossy finish.

json.highest_impact_fix: Align the camera's pitch and yaw angles to match the low oblique perspective of the reference video, and soften the shadow rendering to eliminate the harsh, sharp-edged shadows.
